questions.learningObjective: Compute surface area of a cube with fractional edge
questions.stem: A projection cube has edge length 2.5 units; what is its total surface area?
questions.explanation: Six faces each 6.25 give 37.5. Using 2.5 cubed would give volume.

questions.learningObjective: Compute volume of a prism with trapezoidal base and height
questions.stem: A cartographer's prism has trapezoidal base area 14 square units and height 3 units; what is its volume?
questions.explanation: Volume equals base area times height: 14 times 3 equals 42. Adding gives 17.
questions.hint: Multiply base area by prism height.

questions.topic: Surface area of a rectangular prism
questions.learningObjective: Compute surface area with given dimensions
questions.stem: A projection box measures 1 by 2 by 3 units; what is its total surface area?
questions.explanation: Surface area equals 2(2+3+6) equals 22. Summing pairs once gives 11.
questions.hint: Double the sum of pair products.

questions.learningObjective: Compute cylinder volume with radius 1
questions.stem: A cartographer's cylinder has radius 1 unit and height 7 units; what is its volume? Use pi as 3.14.

options.text: The volume is about 6.28 cubic units, using circumference.
The volume is about 43.96 cubic units, doubling the answer.
The volume is about 21.98 cubic units, from 3.14 times 1 times 7.
The volume is about 3.14 cubic units, using pi only.

questions.explanation: Volume is pi r squared h: 3.14 times 1 times 7 equals 21.98. Doubling or using circumference would be wrong.

questions.learningObjective: Compute cone volume with radius 1
questions.stem: A projection cone has radius 1 unit and height 6 units; what is its volume? Use pi as 3.14.
questions.explanation: Volume is one-third times 3.14 times 1 times 6 equals 6.28. Omitting one-third gives 18.84.

questions.learningObjective: Compute volume of composite solid by addition of prism and cylinder
questions.stem: A projection model is a 3 by 3 by 2 prism with a cylinder of radius 1 and height 2 on top; what is its approximate volume? Use pi as 3.14.

options.text: The volume is about 30 cubic units, adding dimensions.
The volume is about 18 cubic units, ignoring the cylinder.
The volume is about 6.28 cubic units, using only the cylinder.
The volume is about 24.28 cubic units, 18 plus 6.28.

questions.explanation: Prism volume is 18 and cylinder volume is 3.14 times 1 times 2 equals 6.28, total 24.28. Omitting either part would be wrong.
